title: Task 2: Resolve ordered rules-pack stacks and lookup records
description:
Objective:
Build the deterministic System Stack resolver and provider-neutral lookup API.

Files:
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/stack.ts`
- Create: `packages/core/src/rules/lookup.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/rulesStack.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests for resolving one base pack, ordered add-ons, addon incompatible with base, missing addon dependency, duplicate record key without override, duplicate record key with explicit override, lookup by key, and lookup by exact normalized name within a kind.
2. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesStack.test.ts`; expected: FAIL because stack resolver exports do not exist.
3. Implement `resolveRulesStack({ base, addons })` returning a resolved stack with ordered packs and merged record index.
4. Implement `lookupRulesRecord(stack, input)` where input is `{ kind, ref }` or `{ kind, name }`; return record, source pack metadata, license, and override chain on success.
5. Export resolver and lookup APIs from `packages/core/src/index.ts`.
6. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesStack.test.ts`; expected: PASS.
7. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/rules packages/core/src/index.ts packages/core/test/rulesStack.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-rules-stack-lookup`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run packages/core/test/rulesStack.test.ts` passes. Stack resolution validates compatibility, dependency order, and explicit overrides. Lookup returns record, source pack, license, and override chain.
close_reason: Implemented rules stack resolution and lookup; spec and code-quality reviews passed after collision/identity fixes; verification: rulesStack/rulesPack focused tests and forced tsc passed.
